categories.main_business_segments: Okta operates as a single reportable segment focused on identity management, with two primary product lines: Workforce Identity Cloud (for employee, contractor, and partner identity and access management) and Customer Identity Cloud (for customer-facing application identity management, including the Auth0 platform). Both clouds are powered by the Okta Identity Platform and serve distinct but complementary use cases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Okta's core technology is its multi-tenant, cloud-native Okta Identity Platform, which provides secure, scalable, and highly available identity and access management services. The platform leverages modular Okta Platform Services (such as Identity Engine, Workflows, Directories, Integrations, and Insights) and supports extensive integrations with third-party applications and infrastructure. Okta emphasizes robust security practices, continuous software updates, and compliance with industry certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, etc.).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Okta serves over 17,600 customers across nearly every industry, including large enterprises, small and medium-sized businesses, universities, non-profits, and government agencies. Key end markets include organizations seeking secure workforce access, as well as developers and companies building customer-facing applications that require secure, seamless identity experiences.
categories.geographic_coverage: Okta operates globally, with approximately 22% of revenue generated outside the United States as of fiscal 2023. The company has offices and customers in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific regions, and continues to expand its international footprint, particularly in Europe and APAC.
categories.supply_chain_position: Okta operates as a downstream SaaS provider, delivering cloud-based identity and access management solutions directly to end customers and through channel partners. It sits at the application/service layer, integrating with both upstream infrastructure providers and downstream end-user applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Okta's strategic priorities include expanding its customer base (land-and-expand model), deepening relationships with existing customers through cross-selling and upselling, growing its international presence, and leveraging its partner ecosystem. R&D focuses on platform innovation, new product development, expanding integrations, supporting new use cases (such as Zero Trust security), and leveraging analytics and data insights. Okta also pursues selective acquisitions to enhance its platform (e.g., Auth0, atSpoke).
categories.revenue_model: Okta generates revenue primarily through multi-year subscriptions to its cloud-based identity offerings, with subscription fees based on products used and number of users. Subscription revenue accounted for 97% of total revenue in fiscal 2023. The company also earns revenue from professional services and support, but these are a small portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Okta's principal competitor is Microsoft, with additional competition from other authentication, lifecycle management, multi-factor authentication, infrastructure-as-a-service, and customer identity providers, as well as in-house solutions. Okta differentiates itself as an independent, neutral, best-of-breed identity platform with broad integrations and a focus on both workforce and customer identity. The company is recognized as a leader in the identity management market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended January 31, 2023, Okta reported $1.86 billion in revenue, representing 43% year-over-year growth. The company had over 17,600 customers, including 3,930 with annual contract value above $100,000. Okta has a history of net losses (net loss of $815 million in FY23) and continues to invest heavily in growth, with a strong recurring revenue base and high dollar-based net retention (120%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Okta offers a secure, scalable, and neutral identity platform that simplifies digital access for organizations and their users, enabling secure connections to any technology or application. Its value proposition centers on ease of integration, broad compatibility, rapid deployment, robust security, and a consumer-like user experience. Okta's independence from major infrastructure providers, extensive integration network, and focus on both workforce and customer identity use cases provide strong differentiation.
